mapping.backingSize: logical region bytes or exactly page-rounded region bytes

rules: Publish dry-ready only after metadata and actual dry samples are written.
Only the adapter holding processing may write wet samples; publish wet-ready after all writes.
Accept wet output only for the exact generation, sequence and actual frame count.
Reject nonfinite samples before copying any part of the result; zero-valued output is valid.
Cancellation never steals a processing slot; the adapter must release ownership before reuse.
An adapter crash can leave slots processing: recovery uses a fresh mapping, never resets the live region.
Immutable format/ABI header is initialized before sharing and cannot change during mapping lifetime.
No native PCM payloads or mapping names are exposed through renderer or sandbox plugin IPC.
Block exchange supplies no delay line, latency compensation, output device, EOF or drain authority.
